name: First War
summary: The First War drove Stormwind's survivors north after the kingdom fell. The five-year conflict began when the Orcish Horde crossed the Dark Portal and ended with King Llane Wrynn I dead and Stormwind in ruins.

sections.title: Opening of the Portal
sections.body:
For years after the Gnoll War, the Knights of Stormwind and the Clerics of Northshire Abbey guarded a peaceful kingdom. Then Guardian Medivh, secretly possessed by the demon lord Sargeras, contacted the orc warlock Gul'dan on Draenor. Together, they forged the Dark Portal in the Black Morass.

Driven by demon blood and the slow death of their homeworld, the Orcish Horde crossed into Azeroth in force. Some dismissed the first reports as vengeful spirits or strange offshoots of trolls. Sir Anduin Lothar's scouting patrols soon confirmed a disciplined, bloodthirsty army had arrived.

sections.title: The War for Stormwind
sections.body:
Warchief Blackhand led the Horde openly, while Gul'dan's Shadow Council guided it from the shadows. The Horde overran the kingdom's southern reaches. An attempt to push into Stranglethorn Vale against the Gurubashi trolls failed, yet the campaign across human lands brought ruin.

The Horde conquered until only Elwynn Forest remained under human control. Blackhand then launched a direct assault on Stormwind City. Sir Anduin Lothar repelled it with a surprise flanking attack by sea, saving the capital from destruction for a time.

sections.title: Treachery and the Fall
sections.body:
Sir Anduin Lothar and the young mage Khadgar uncovered Medivh's betrayal. They invaded Karazhan and slew the Guardian. Medivh's death left Gul'dan in a coma, giving Orgrim Doomhammer the chance to challenge and kill Blackhand in a mak'gora duel. Doomhammer took absolute command, crushed the Shadow Council, and began a second siege of Stormwind.

During the attack, the half-orc assassin Garona murdered King Llane Wrynn I inside his keep. The Horde sacked and burned Stormwind to ash. Lothar gathered the survivors and fled north across the Great Sea to Lordaeron.

faq.q: How did the orcs get to Azeroth in the first place?
faq.answer: The orc warlock Gul'dan on Draenor and Guardian Medivh on Azeroth joined forces to open the Dark Portal in the Black Morass with dark fel magic.

faq.q: Why didn't the other human kingdoms help Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind stood alone because the distant northern kingdoms dismissed reports of green-skinned invaders as wild exaggerations or local disputes. The northern kings united only after Stormwind fell and Lothar reached Lordaeron with boats full of refugees.
Garona Halforcen, an emissary trusted by King Llane Wrynn I, assassinated him inside his own keep during the final siege, dealing a severe blow to human morale.

faq.q: Did the orcs fight anyone besides humans in the First War?
faq.answer: Yes. The Horde pushed south into Stranglethorn Vale early in the war, but the Gurubashi jungle trolls repelled them in a fierce clash.
The Orcish Horde won the First War. Stormwind was razed, King Llane was slain, and the surviving humans fled by sea to Lordaeron.
After Medivh's death left Gul'dan incapacitated, Orgrim Doomhammer challenged Blackhand to mak'gora, slew him, and took command of the Horde.

angles.text: For humans, the First War brought Stormwind to its darkest hour. The kingdom fell, its king was murdered, and its survivors fled across the sea as penniless refugees.
For orcs, the First War began their bloody conquest of Azeroth, tainted by Mannoroth's blood-curse and Gul'dan's Shadow Council working in secret.
The slaughter of the Clerics of Northshire Abbey showed that holy faith alone could not withstand brutal melee combat. It inspired the founding of the Knights of the Silver Hand.
Stormwind's destruction warned the northern nations to abandon their isolation and unite as the Alliance of Lordaeron.
Gul'dan and his Shadow Council guided the Horde's conquests with fel sorceries, showing the devastation demonic pacts can unleash upon the world.
